limits: This is a single-process, non-overlapping validation-session helper; its scoped global patches are not a concurrent evaluator service.
Accounted object bytes are not a hard process working-set cap.
Owner synthetic tests and separate matched-output/clock benchmarks are not independent performance recomputation by this reviewer.

review_findings.finding: Owner identified potential subclass hash/equality impersonation of a bank reference.
review_findings.resolution: Bank validation requires the stored reference to be the same Python object before admitting its parsed capture.

review_scope: Read-only source review; no independent test rerun, live input reads, evaluation, runtime integration or source edits.
verified_boundaries: Original capture validation precedes admission of detached canonical bytes and recursively immutable parsed values.
Opaque references require exact bank-owned identity, including the explicit same-reference check against hash/equality impersonation.
Cached semantic hashes require the exact immutable nested objects plus exact scalar types/values and complete field identity.
Bisect target lookup matches the frozen branch order and rechecks current maturity each call; the original rolling source election and scoring remain unchanged.
Bounded bank overflow follows original validation, with no source-domain truncation; dynamic clocks, failures and whole scores are not cached.
Source hashes bracket execution and patched functions are restored on exit.
